name: LECmd
description: A tool for parsing .LNK files, which are indicative of file access on Windows systems.
author: Eric Zimmerman
features: Parses .LNK files to extract metadata and timestamps
Supports parsing of all files in a directory, regardless of extension
Provides detailed information about the target file and its access history
Can output data in various formats for further analysis

examples.description: Parsing .LNK files with LECmd without the `-q` switch to display parsed data in console.
Outputting parsed data into a CSV file for ingestion into Timeline Explorer.
Generating an HTML report with detailed information about the target file and its access history.

Console: Timestamps: SourceCreated, SourceModified, SourceAccessed, TargetCreated, TargetModified, TargetAccessed
Attributes: SourceFile, FileSize, WorkingDirectory, DriveType, VolumeSerialNumber, LocalPath, TargetMFTEntryNumber, TargetMFTSequenceNumber, MachineID, MachineMACAddress, MACVendor
CSV: Timestamps and attributes in CSV format for easy ingestion into tools like Timeline Explorer.
JSON: Parsed data in JSON format for further analysis or integration with other systems.
XML: Parsed data in XML format for structured storage and retrieval.
HTML: Detailed HTML report with visual representation of parsed data.
